findings.message: Scope in authors `kill-cli-activation` and `heartbeat` together, plus `phase3-continue-12`. Section 20 puts `kill-cli-activation` in its own admission ('`kill-cli-activation` alone') and puts `heartbeat` in the next one. The carried list `[kill-cli-activation]`, `[heartbeat]`, ... follows the same split: under the established pattern (`test_seeded_phase3_core.py` PHASE3_REMAINDER), the list starts with this continuation's own admission. If this continuation authors `heartbeat` too, it merges two admissions into one. That contradicts the 'alone' marking, and `phase3-continue-12` then has no consistent shrinking suffix: it would either author `heartbeat` again or start from a list that still shows `heartbeat` as unseeded. The acceptance criterion's suffix-equality pin cannot be satisfied alongside the carried list.
findings.paved_road: Author only `kill-cli-activation` and `phase3-continue-12` (2 seeds, within cap 3). `kill-cli-activation` depends on `phase3-continue-11`; `phase3-continue-12` depends on `kill-cli-activation`. Keep the carried admission list starting with `[kill-cli-activation]`, and pin the successor's suffix as that list minus its head, starting at `[heartbeat]`. Remove `heartbeat` from this batch's identities, edges, budgets, and new-path owners.
